jobs.description: Accelerate your career. Join the organization that's driving the world's technology and shape the future. Ingram Micro is a leading technology company for the global information technology ecosystem. With the ability to reach nearly 90% of the global population, we play a vital role in the worldwide IT sales channel, bringing products and services from technology manufacturers and cloud providers to business-to-business technology experts. Our market reach, diverse solutions and services portfolio, and digital platform Ingram Micro Xvantage™ set us apart. Learn more at www.ingrammicro.com Come join our team where you’ll make technology happen in surprising ways. Let’s shape tomorrow - it’ll be a fun journey! The Sr. Platform, AI Solutions Specialist will drive adoption of intelligent, automated workflows within the Global Platform Group, shifting delivery from manual, effort-driven processes to AI-enabled operations that accelerate delivery and improve accuracy and consistency. As the Platform grows and demand increases, delivery workflows — particularly feature intake, capturing business requirements and use cases, solution and sizing, prioritization, and full testing accuracy and execution — have become resource-intensive, complex, and difficult to scale. This role will uncover experiences, build requirements, and partner closely with our AI technology team to deliver AI solutions that streamline key stages of the delivery lifecycle — from intake and business requirements definition through development and deployment — reducing cycle times, minimizing rework, and enabling teams to focus on higher-value activities. The AI Solutions Specialist is also an enabler and multiplier for the broader GPB organization: well-versed in business AI solutions such as Microsoft Copilot and Claude, sharing best practices, producing GPB-specific trainings, and ensuring teams can effectively leverage emerging AI capabilities and embed AI into day-to-day operations. This role directly supports a scalable operating model that can meet growing demand without proportional resource increases — delivering faster delivery cycles through automation of intake, prioritization, and execution processes; improved quality and consistency with reduced manual errors and rework; increased capacity by eliminating low-value, repetitive tasks; and stronger decision-making through AI-driven insights and predictive intelligence. AI fluency has been identified by GPB leadership as a critical capability to deliver on strategic priorities and meet future business needs over the next three years. Your role: AI Solution Discovery & Requirements Uncover experiences and build requirements to shift manual, effort-driven processes to intelligent, automated workflows that accelerate delivery and improve accuracy and consistency. Identify, assess, and prioritize high-impact AI and automation use cases across the delivery lifecycle — feature intake, business requirements and use case capture, solution and sizing, prioritization, and testing. Document current-state workflows, quantify pain points, and define clear target-state designs and success criteria for each AI solution. Translate business needs into structured requirements, use cases, and BRDs that the AI technology team can build against. AI Delivery & Lifecycle Automation Work closely with the AI technology team on the delivery of AI solutions, serving as the business-side owner from concept through development and deployment. Streamline key stages of the delivery lifecycle — from intake and business requirements definition through development and deployment — reducing cycle times and minimizing rework. Pilot, test, and iterate on AI solutions with working teams; validate outputs for accuracy, quality, and fit before scaling. Improve full testing accuracy and execution through AI-assisted approaches, reducing manual errors and rework. Enable teams to focus on higher-value activities by eliminating low-value, repetitive tasks through automation. Training, Upskilling & Enablement Maintain deep, hands-on fluency in business AI solutions such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude, and emerging AI tools; evaluate new capabilities as they become available. Share best practices and produce GPB-specific trainings, playbooks, and enablement materials that raise AI fluency across the organization. Upskill and enable the broader GPB organization, ensuring teams can effectively leverage emerging AI capabilities and embed AI into day-to-day operations. Serve as an AI champion and change agent — building confidence, driving adoption, and helping teams navigate new ways of working. Insights, Impact & Responsible Use Leverage AI to improve daily task efficiency and drive better decision-making through data-driven insights and predictive intelligence. Define and track KPIs that quantify efficiency gains, quality improvements, capacity created, and delivery-cycle acceleration from AI adoption. Contribute to a scalable operating model that supports growing demand without proportional resource increases. Apply sound judgment on responsible AI use — data handling, accuracy validation, and appropriate human oversight — in line with company policies and guidelines. What you bring to the role: Experience & Education Bachelor's degree (or equivalent combination of education and experience) required. 5+ years of functional experience, including a minimum of 3 year in a directly related role such as AI/automation enablement, business analysis, solutions consulting, process improvement, or platform operations. Demonstrated, hands-on experience applying business AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT) and/or automation platforms (e.g., Power Automate) to real business workflows. Track record of gathering requirements, documenting workflows, and partnering with technical teams to deliver solutions from concept through deployment. Experience developing and delivering training or enablement programs strongly preferred. Preferred: Active project or program management certification such as PMP®, CAPM®, PMI-ACP, or equivalent; AI, automation, or Power Platform certifications a plus. Skills & Competencies AI Fluency: Deep working knowledge of business AI solutions such as Microsoft Copilot and Claude, including practical prompt engineering, capability assessment, and knowing when (and when not) to apply AI to a workflow. Process Analysis & Workflow Automation: Strong instinct for breaking down complex delivery workflows, identifying automation opportunities, and redesigning processes for intelligent execution. Requirements Definition: Skilled at translating business needs into structured requirements, use cases, and BRDs that technical teams can deliver against. Platform & Business Acumen: Ability to quickly develop deep familiarity with Xvantage™, the delivery lifecycle, and the broader Ingram Micro ecosystem. Training & Enablement: Able to design and deliver engaging trainings, playbooks, and best-practice content that makes AI approachable for non-technical audiences. Change Leadership: Proven ability to champion new tools and ways of working, build adoption momentum, and bring teams along with clarity and empathy. Data-Driven Mindset: Comfortable defining metrics, measuring impact, and using data and AI-driven insights to inform prioritization and decision-making. Responsible AI Judgment: Understanding of data privacy, accuracy validation, and appropriate human oversight when deploying AI in business processes. Communication & Presentation: Polished written and verbal communicator; comfortable presenting AI concepts and solution results clearly to audiences from working teams to senior leadership. Tooling Proficiency: Strong command of Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint); experience with Power Automate, Power Apps, Power BI, Jira, and Confluence preferred. General proficiency with various tools, systems, and procedures required to accomplish the job. Preferred: Completed project or program management certification including Certified Project Manager (IAPM), Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM) ®, Project Management Professional (PMP) ®, Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP), or other equivalents. Company Introduction
We exist to wow our customers. We know we’re doing the right thing when we hear our customers say, “How did I ever live without Coupang?” Born out of an obsession to make shopping, eating, and living easier than ever, we’re collectively disrupting the multi-billion-dollar e-commerce industry from the ground up. We are proud to have the best of both worlds — a startup culture with the resources of a large global public company. Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what’s possible to solve problems and break traditional trade-offs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always-on, high-tech, and hyper-connected world.

Role Overview
Fulfilment Optimization (FO) owns the systems that decide how every Coupang order is planned, distributed, and fulfilled. Our Tier-1 services sit on the critical path of Coupang's ecommerce order flow — processing every order in real time across Korea and Taiwan. We operate multiple interconnected platform components:
-Business Engine — Core order planning and distribution orchestrator (Kotlin/Spring Boot). Runs 5 distinct pipelines (Domestic, Cross-Market, 3PL, PDD, Replan) using a hexagonal architecture with pluggable processors, pruners, and manifest-based orchestration.
-Planner Solver — Mixed-Integer Programming (MIP) optimization engine (Python/CPLEX) that minimizes total fulfilment cost across inventory, capacity, network, and delivery-promise constraints with sub-second latency requirements.
-Network Manager — Manages fulfilment network topology, transportation cost, FC capacity, middle-mile logistics, and cross-FC consolidation (CFCC) across 90+ REST/gRPC endpoints.
-FO Inventory — Real-time inventory availability, allocation, SKU management, and event-driven sync across multiple upstream sources (Kafka, Cassandra, Elasticsearch, Redis).
-WMS Fulfilment — Order distribution, inventory allocation, fulfilment centre orchestration, shipment, delivery, and outbound management (Java/Spring, 138+ domain subpackages, Drools rules engine).
-Online Simulation — Real-time simulation platform for testing planning changes against production-like order streams.
-FO Workflows — Temporal-based workflow orchestration for long-running fulfilment processes.

The Role
We are looking for a Senior Staff Engineer who can operate across deep implementation and broad architecture. You will set the technical direction for Tier-1 fulfilment systems, write and review production code, design systems that scale under heavy ecommerce traffic, and raise the engineering bar across the organization. The engineer in this role will directly influence how millions of orders are fulfilled every day. Every architectural decision — solver latency, pruning strategy, network cost calculation, inventory allocation algorithm impacts
customer delivery promise, fulfilment cost, and operational efficiency across Coupang's entire ecommerce platform in Korea and Taiwan.
This is a rare opportunity to work at the intersection of large-scale distributed systems, real-time optimization, and ecommerce fulfilment — with direct, measurable business impact.
What You Will Do
-Design and build scalable, reliable Tier-1 services for order planning, fulfilment optimization, inventory allocation, and network cost management — systems that process every Coupang order in real time.
-Own architecture across distributed systems involving gRPC service meshes, Kafka event pipelines, CPLEX optimization solvers, multi-layer caching (Redis, S3-backed Loadable Stores), and multi-region deployments.
-Write production code in Kotlin and Java and set the bar for correctness, performance, and operational safety across the team.
-Lead design and code reviews — identify correctness issues, scalability risks, and operational gaps in systems handling latency-sensitive order flows (sub-second solver deadlines, P99 monitoring with 3-5s alert thresholds).
-Drive reliability for mission-critical services — circuit breakers, graceful degradation (hard/soft pruners with fallback), observability, and incident prevention.
-Partner with Product, Data Science, and Operations to translate fulfilment optimization goals into technical execution — PDD rationalization, CFCC (Cross-FC Consolidation), CFlow transport planning, inventory group management, and solver model improvements.
-Mentor engineers and create durable technical mechanisms (pipeline patterns, adapter abstractions, feature flag discipline) that scale beyond individual projects

-Excellent hands-on coding ability in Kotlin or Java (backend systems at scale)
-Deep understanding of system design — API design, concurrency, data modelling, caching strategies, messaging, service-to-service communication (gRPC, REST)
-Strong code review skills — ability to identify subtle correctness, performance, and reliability issues in complex
codebases
-Experience with production-grade systems handling high QPS, large data volumes, or Tier-1 SLAs
-Experience with event-driven architectures using Kafka at scale
-Experience with multi-region systems — region-specific routing, data isolation, cross-border fulfilment
-Experience with resilience engineering — circuit breakers, retry strategies, load testing, capacity planning, graceful degradation patterns
-Track record of technical leadership — setting architecture direction, driving cross-team alignment, mentoring senior engineers

Preferred Qualifications

-Experience with optimization systems — solvers (CPLEX, OR-Tools), decision engines, constraint programming, or data-science-integrated production systems
-Experience with Agentic AI tools for development and code review — using AI-assisted coding agents (e.g., Cursor, Copilot, Devin, Claude Code) to accelerate development velocity, improve code review quality, and automate repetitive engineering tasks
-Experience with Spec-Driven Development — defining system behaviour through specifications (OpenAPI/Swagger, Protocol Buffers, API-first design, contract-first development) before implementation, ensuring well-defined contracts between services

jobs.description: Wilson is seeking a motivated, consultative and experienced Recruitment Consultant to join our collaborative, dynamic and talented team. Someone that will play an integral part in acting as a trusted client advisor and candidate advocate. In this role, you will combine cutting-edge recruitment strategies and market intelligence to deliver the best talent to meet the critical recruiting needs of our clients. We’re looking for individuals who demonstrate a strong, independent work ethic, knowledge of best practices for attracting top talent, the ability to develop and nurture strong working relationships and a passion for providing excellent client satisfaction. Our Recruiters provide an exceptional candidate experience through management of all aspects of the recruiting process including sourcing, screening, interviewing and recommending candidates for both interviews and for hire. YOU WILL: - Oversee the selection process including identifying and assessing candidates, conducting initial phone screens, facilitating interviews and gathering feedback from our clients and candidates. - Build and maintain a strong network of candidates through market research and on-going bench management, demonstrating the ability to anticipate client needs and hiring manager preferences by delivering strong submit -to-interview and interview-to-offer ratios. - Develop a creative and proactive recruitment strategy to identify both passive and active candidates. - Present strong talent for open positions and overcome objections in the hiring process. - Consult with hiring managers (clients) in final selections, compensation and recruitment processes focusing on adding value and doing what is best for the client. - Maintain strong client and candidate relationships and satisfaction. - Ensure weekly and monthly submit and hire goals are met. - Update and maintain reports, such as applicant tracking system data and reports, along with other related administrative responsibilities. REQUIREMENTS: - Proven ability to successfully perform all aspects of recruiting , including competitive market research, passive sourcing, advanced internet searches, negotiating and closing candidates while achieving results in a fast-paced, metrics and deadline - driven recruiting environment. - Ability to exceed performance expectations and goals, as well as implement feedback to achieve desired outcomes. - Keep the recruiting pipeline in mind at all times. Additionally, you must be able to confidently communicate the pipeline to others. - Strong client focus and commitment to continuous improvement. - Ability to execute recruitment strategies, including clear articulation of RPO and client relationship. - Possesses strong time prioritization skills, embraces change and demonstrates flexibility when directions and priorities shift. - Actively participates on recruiting team and looks for ways to add value in addition to fostering an environment of open collaboration. - Demonstrated computer proficiency , including intermediate MS office skills, experience working in an applicant tracking system and a strong social media presence. Recruitment Consultant (52k -102k CAD) or (50k-70k USD) The Salary for this position is anticipated to range between 52k to 102k annually for Canada or 50k to 70k annually for USA. This range is a good-faith estimate, based on the Country / Location and qualifications necessary for the position, including experience, skills, training, and other considerations permitted by law. Factors that may be used when making an offer may include, but are not limited to, a candidate’s skills, experience and geographic location, the expected quality and quantity of work, and any client specific specifications. Most candidates will start at the bottom half of the pay range. The upper end of the range will generally be reserved for candidates with extensive experience and skills and who live in geographic markets commanding a higher starting pay. An employee’s pay history will not be a contributing factor where prohibited by local law. In addition to salary, Wilson offers bonus/commission programs, a competitive benefits package, including health insurance coverage, retirement plan, an employee wellness program, life and disability, and unlimited PTO.

Overview

StoneX Financial Europe SA (‘SFE’) is directly regulated by the CSSF and by virtue of passporting into other EU states indirectly subject also to other local regulators. It is authorized as a €730k firm, with wide ranging permissions with offices in Luxembourg, Frankfurt, Dublin and Madrid. The Luxembourg head office trades as principal (bask to back) in interest rate swaps, fixed income contracts, while the Dublin branch is an advisor in commodities and is permitted to ‘receive and transmit’ orders to affiliate companies in UK and USA. A newly established branch in Madrid is authorized to receive and transmit orders for clients to be place via the UK affiliate onto the London Metal exchange. SFE is within the group of companies ultimately owned and controlled by Stone Group Inc. which is a Fortune 500 company, with a market capitalization of $1 billion, providing customers across the globe with services including execution and advisory services in commodities, capital markets, currencies and asset management.

Other companies within the EU that are 100% owned and controlled by the group are:

• StoneX Financial GmbH, Frankfurt – a Payments Service provider, trades as principal
• StoneX Financial Europe GmbH, Hamburg - Active in Industrial and basemetals
• StoneX Europe Ltd, Cyprus – Active in retail investment through forex.com
• StoneX Bullion GmbH Frankfurt - trading as principal (precious metals)
• StoneX Switzerland S.A. – Cotton trader

This is a unique opportunity to get hands-on experience across a multitude of topics concerning accounting function of a financial services organization. You will be part of a international team and contribute to the preparation and analysis of our financials. You will be hands-on in our day-to-day business in various tasks, including accounts receivables & payables. You will assist projects to further develop our financial processes and best-practices. Your touchpoints will include the Finance & Accounting team and select stakeholders across the organization. During your internship, you will support us in processes and automation in finance and accounts receivable and account payables management.

Responsibilities

Position Purpose: We are seeking a highly capable working student to support the local controller in Frankfurt in various daily, monthly, and yearly financial tasks. The role will provide invaluable experience in accounting, financial reporting, and business analysis within a dynamic financial services company.

General Duties and Responsibilities:

• Daily Work:

• Support in invoicing processes and assist in the implementation of accounts receivable (AR) modules.

• Monthly Work:

• Assist with bank reconciliations and system reconciliations.
• Perform variance analysis of balance sheet and profit and loss accounts.
• Help with regulatory reporting and calculation of KPIs.

• Yearly Work:

• Assist in the preparation of Lagebericht (management report) and Anhang (notes) in accordance with German GAAP (HGB).

Qualifications

Early Careers Requirement Qualifications:

• Education:

• Enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master’s degree program in Accounting, Finance, Audit, or Project Management (preferably with 2 years left to study).

• Skills and Experience:

• Strong knowledge of German GAAP (HGB) and accounting principles.
• Advanced MS Excel, MS Word, and MS PowerPoint skills; familiarity with database queries is a plus.
• Previous exposure to ERP systems (preferably ORACLE) and initial project management experience is desirable.

• Languages:

• Fluent in both English and German (written and spoken). French would be an advantage.

• Key Attributes:

• Strong organizational and time management skills to meet deadlines.
• Ability to work proactively and independently, with a willingness to ask for help when needed.
• Excellent communication skills (both verbal and written).
• Strong attention to detail and a commitment to high-quality work.
• Ability to engage with stakeholders to improve business performance and address key issues proactively.
• A mindset focused on continuous improvement, self-motivation, and agility.
• Strong ethical focus in all tasks.
